title: Minestria.com
description: Minestria is a competitive PvP server where you build a private dungeon, fight over shards in open‑world rifts, and raid other players for their wealth.
body:
Minestria is a next‑gen RPG survival server built around one core idea: every player owns a personal dungeon heart in the void, and everything you do in the world powers it up. Spawn in your underground base, guided by your Echo companion, and expand your dungeon room by room to unlock shard income, themed wings, helpers, and a brutal Dungeon Master golem that defends your wealth.

Head to the custom‑generated Overworld, Nether, and End to farm materials, run rift events, and hunt for upgrade cores and gems. Rifts spawn escalating waves of mobs for huge rewards, while expeditions and daily quests keep your progression moving even when you are not grinding nonstop. Powerful gear can be enhanced with gem builds and core upgrades, but true +10 items are rare trophies that only the most dedicated players will ever reach.

When you are ready, challenge other players through the raid system: fight a scaled golem reflection of their dungeon in a dedicated arena and steal a percentage of their gold and shards without ever griefing their actual base. Clan up, compare dungeon levels and “hearts stolen” on leaderboards, and specialize your build for PvE farming or PvP raiding. With smart item‑loss rules, you can bring your best gear into dangerous content without fearing a single mistake will delete months of progress.

If you like deep progression, meaningful risk, and a server that feels like a living RPG rather than just another SMP, Minestria is built for you.
